bull_bear.body:
- Established manufacturing capabilities supported by experienced management and operational expertise (Steel)
- Long-standing relationships with customers across diverse industrial sectors (Steel)
- Diversified customer base reducing dependence on any single industry or customer segment (Steel)
- Strong corporate governance framework and disciplined financial management (Steel)
- Established GOELD brand presence in the frozen food industry (Agro)
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Raw material and energy price volatility in Steel — Volatility in prices of iron ore, coking coal, ferro alloys, fuel and power can significantly impact manufacturing costs and operating margins; geopolitical developments and supply chain disruptions may further affect raw material availability and logistics costs.
- Import competition and trade-policy exposure in Steel — The domestic industry faces pricing pressure from imported steel products, particularly during periods of excess global production capacity; changes in international trade policies, anti-dumping measures and import duties may influence market dynamics.
- Environmental/decarbonization compliance cost in Steel — Increasing environmental regulations, evolving ESG expectations and decarbonization initiatives may require additional investments in cleaner technologies and sustainable manufacturing practices.
- Cold-chain dependency in Agro (Frozen Foods) — The frozen food business remains dependent upon efficient cold chain infrastructure, uninterrupted refrigeration and reliable logistics networks; any disruption may adversely impact product quality and increase operating costs.
- Agricultural raw-material seasonality in Agro — Raw material availability and pricing for the frozen food business are influenced by agricultural output, seasonal variations and climatic conditions, alongside inflationary pressure on packaging, transportation and energy costs.
- Competitive intensity in frozen foods — The Agro Division operates in an increasingly competitive market with large organized players, regional manufacturers and private-label brands, requiring continuous innovation, brand building and customer engagement to sustain market position.
- General enterprise risk factors flagged by management — Board-level risk management identifies fluctuations in raw material and energy prices, changes in market demand, regulatory developments, supply chain disruptions, foreign exchange movements and evolving competitive dynamics as the Company's key risks, mitigated through operational efficiencies, diversified sourcing and prudent financial management.
bull_bear.title: Bear — key risks

business.body: Shri Bajrang Alliance Limited operates through two complementary segments: Steel, which manufactures structural steel products for infrastructure, construction, engineering and industrial customers, and Agro (Frozen Foods), which makes and markets GOELD-branded frozen snacks, vegetables and Indian breads. The diversified model is intended to mitigate sector-specific cyclicality while capturing India's infrastructure and consumption-led growth.
business.title: What they do

business.body:
- **Steel:** Structural steel products
- **Agro:** GOELD frozen snacks, GOELD frozen vegetables, GOELD frozen Indian breads, value-added convenience food products

- Strong corporate governance framework and disciplined financial management (Steel)
- Established GOELD brand presence in the frozen food industry (Agro)
business.title: Competitive strengths

outlook.body:
- Pursue a balanced, diversified two-segment strategy (Steel + Agro) to mitigate sector-specific cyclicality while capturing India's infrastructure and consumption-led growth
- In Steel, focus on operational efficiency, product quality, customer relationships, cost competitiveness and evaluation of process improvements and technological upgrades
- In Agro, strengthen the GOELD brand through distribution network expansion, increased participation in modern trade, institutional sales and export markets, and continuous introduction of innovative products
- Increase adoption of technology-driven business processes to improve operational planning, supply chain visibility, customer engagement and decision-making
- Maintain prudent financial discipline and disciplined management approach across both segments
- The Board has not recommended any dividend for FY26 and has decided not to transfer any amount to Reserves, stating the intent to conserve resources for the better working of the Company — indicating a capital-conservation/reinvestment posture over shareholder payout.
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: During FY2025-26 the Company received regulatory approval to expand its steel rolling mill capacity from 46,000 metric tonnes per annum to 1,00,000 metric tonnes per annum, based on the proposed use of Natural Gas (PNG) in the reheating furnace. The initiative is expected to enhance operational efficiency, improve energy utilisation and support environmentally responsible manufacturing practices. No commissioning or completion timeline is stated in this bundle.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- Indian steel demand supported by sustained government infrastructure spending on roads, railways, urban development and renewable energy
- National Steel Policy 2017 and the PLI Scheme for Specialty Steel expected to promote capacity expansion, value addition, technological advancement and import substitution in the steel industry
- Steel industry margins pressured by volatility in iron ore, coking coal and ferro alloy prices, increasing low-cost imports and evolving environmental regulations
- Frozen food demand driven by urbanization, rising disposable incomes, expansion of organized retail, modern trade and quick commerce, and institutional demand from QSRs/hotels/food service operators
- Export opportunities for Indian ethnic frozen foods expanding across North America, Europe, Middle East, Australia and South-East Asia, supported by the Indian diaspora
- Frozen food industry faces cost pressure from packaging, transportation and energy costs, seasonal raw-material availability and rising competition from domestic and international brands
- Company's diversified Steel + Agro portfolio positioned to benefit from both continued infrastructure development and structural changes in consumer food consumption patterns
outlook.title: Demand & outlook drivers
